data.one_liner: PayPal SDK for integrating PayPal REST APIs in Dart/Flutter apps.
data.what_it_does: Provides Dart wrappers for PayPal REST endpoints such as catalog products, orders, payments, subscriptions, and webhooks. Handles authentication, request building, and response parsing for PayPal services.
use_when: You need to call PayPal REST APIs directly from a Flutter/Dart app
You want a pure‑Dart client that works on mobile, web and desktop
You need built‑in support for PayPal orders, subscriptions or webhooks
avoid_when: You require a payment gateway other than PayPal
You need a full‑featured UI checkout flow (the SDK is API‑only)
You prefer a server‑side integration for security reasons
strengths: Covers most PayPal APIs (orders, payments, subscriptions, webhooks)
Simple to add as a regular dependency
weaknesses: Limited to PayPal only, no multi‑gateway support
No code‑generated models or UI components
Manual error handling and request construction required
data.setup_notes: Add paypal_sdk to pubspec.yaml, run flutter pub get, and provide PayPal client ID/secret as per PayPal docs.

alternatives.name: http
alternatives.why_pick_it: General purpose HTTP client; you can call PayPal APIs manually without a dedicated SDK

alternatives.name: dio
alternatives.why_pick_it: Feature‑rich HTTP client with interceptors and better error handling for custom PayPal integration
